metadata.question: Was there an algae bloom visible off the coast of Santa Monica on October 10,  2015?

data.raw_code: The question is about detecting an algae bloom off the coast of Santa Monica on October 10, 2015. For algae detection, I should use: 1. Data: Sentinel-2 is ideal for this as it has good coastal water monitoring capabilities with appropriate bands. 2. Approach: Use chlorophyll-related indices like NDCI (Normalized Difference Chlorophyll Index) or look for high reflectance in the green band that indicates algae presence. 3. Location: Santa Monica coast - I'll define a coastal polygon. 4. Date: October 10, 2015 (single date). 5. Processing: Mask clouds, focus on water pixels, calculate algae indicators. For algae detection, I can use: - NDCI = (B5 - B4) / (B5 + B4) for chlorophyll detection - Or simply look for high green reflectance in water areas I'll check if there's data, then look for high chlorophyll/reflectance values that would indicate an algae bloom. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions santa_monica_coast = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[ [-118.55, 33.95], [-118.45, 33.95], [-118.45, 34.05], [-118.55, 34.05], [-118.55, 33.95] ]]) date = '2015-10-10' # 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-2 for algae detection s2_col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') \ .filterBounds(santa_monica_coast) \ .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) # Check if collection is empty if s2_col.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No Sentinel-2 images found for 2015-10-10") print("C1") else: # Get the image and apply cloud masking image = s2_col.first() # Cloud masking using QA60 band qa = image.select('QA60') cloud_bitmask = 1 << 10 cirrus_bitmask = 1 << 11 mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloud_bitmask).eq(0) \ .And(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrus_bitmask).eq(0)) image = image.updateMask(mask) # Calculate NDCI for chlorophyll detection (B5 - B4)/(B5 + B4) ndci = image.normalizedDifference(['B5', 'B4']).rename('NDCI') # Focus on water areas using NDWI ndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']).rename('NDWI') water_mask = ndwi.gt(0.0) # Positive NDWI indicates water # Apply water mask to NDCI ndci_water = ndci.updateMask(water_mask) # Count valid pixels and calculate stats stats = ndci_water.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count().combine( ee.Reducer.mean(), sharedInputs=True ), geometry=santa_monica_coast, scale=100, maxPixels=1e9 ) count = stats.get('NDCI_count').getInfo() mean_ndci = stats.get('NDCI_mean').getInfo() if count == 0: print("No valid water pixels after cloud masking") print("C2") elif mean_ndci is None: print("Calculation failed") print("C3") else: # Algae bloom threshold: NDCI > 0.1 indicates high chlorophyll print(f"Valid pixels: {count}") print(f"Mean NDCI: {mean_ndci:.3f}") if mean_ndci > 0.1: print("A") # Yes, algae bloom detected else: print("B") # No significant algae bloom ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
santa_monica_coast = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[
    [-118.55, 33.95],
    [-118.45, 33.95],
    [-118.45, 34.05],
    [-118.55, 34.05],
    [-118.55, 33.95]
]])

date = '2015-10-10'

# 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-2 for algae detection
s2_col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') \
    .filterBounds(santa_monica_coast) \
    .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day'))

# Check if collection is empty
if s2_col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No Sentinel-2 images found for 2015-10-10")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # Get the image and apply cloud masking
    image = s2_col.first()
    
    # Cloud masking using QA60 band
    qa = image.select('QA60')
    cloud_bitmask = 1 << 10
    cirrus_bitmask = 1 << 11
    mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloud_bitmask).eq(0) \
            .And(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrus_bitmask).eq(0))
    image = image.updateMask(mask)
    
    # Calculate NDCI for chlorophyll detection (B5 - B4)/(B5 + B4)
    ndci = image.normalizedDifference(['B5', 'B4']).rename('NDCI')
    
    # Focus on water areas using NDWI
    ndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']).rename('NDWI')
    water_mask = ndwi.gt(0.0)  # Positive NDWI indicates water
    
    # Apply water mask to NDCI
    ndci_water = ndci.updateMask(water_mask)
    
    # Count valid pixels and calculate stats
    stats = ndci_water.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count().combine(
            ee.Reducer.mean(), sharedInputs=True
        ),
        geometry=santa_monica_coast,
        scale=100,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    
    count = stats.get('NDCI_count').getInfo()
    mean_ndci = stats.get('NDCI_mean').getInfo()
    
    if count == 0:
        print("No valid water pixels after cloud masking")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif mean_ndci is None:
        print("Calculation failed")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        # Algae bloom threshold: NDCI > 0.1 indicates high chlorophyll
        print(f"Valid pixels: {count}")
        print(f"Mean NDCI: {mean_ndci:.3f}")
        
        if mean_ndci > 0.1:
            print("<answer>A</answer>")  # Yes, algae bloom detected
        else:
            print("<answer>B</answer>")  # No significant algae bloom
